items.statement: The agent declares a bounded molecular search rule before calculation and retains unique candidate identity, structure and mapping.
items.expected: The report gives an explicit generation rule, deduplication rule, candidate list and stopping/coverage statement.

items.statement: Candidates are chemically and computationally validated rather than ranked from labels or unsupported mechanism assertions.
items.expected: Each advanced candidate has formula/atom, connectivity and stationary-point evidence, with failures disclosed.

items.statement: For the source-supported cyclization family, E products are lower than Z products and all cyclized products are above the open reactant.
items.expected: The independent report reaches or carefully qualifies this ordering from its own calculations.

items.statement: The isolated ground-state energy profile cannot by itself prove excited-state photochemical kinetics or crystal-packing causality.
items.expected: The conclusion states this limitation and does not call an electronic energy difference a kinetic activation free energy.
